create_DataGenerator_subclass: create a subclass of DataGenerator that implements the abstract run method for custom data generation
start_DataGenerator_thread: start a DataGenerator instance in a separate daemon thread by calling the start method
check_DataGenerator_finished: check if a DataGenerator task has finished by calling the check_is_finished method
check_DataGenerator_timeout: check if a DataGenerator task has timed out by calling the check_is_timeout method
get_DataGenerator_remaining_time: get the remaining time before a DataGenerator task times out using the get_remaining_time method
